releaseName: Your data download leaves out storage details, and job-ad reading counts toward the day's limit
summary: Download everything no longer includes storage locations, internal account ids, counters shared across the service or the audit log's hash chain. After deleting their only job search, a person sees that they are still signed in, with buttons to start a new job search or sign out. Reading a job ad automatically now takes one model call from the day's allowance; past it the job is saved for the person to fill in, and the screen says so.
knownLimitations: Inviting people to a team still goes through the API or an operator; the account menu does not list the team's people yet. Starting from a conversation needs the server's interviewer model. Signed-in users get the written interview only: live voice shows with the owner token (#2750). Agents cannot add text evidence yet (#2751). Credit packs sell only where the operator has set up Stripe; staging uses Stripe test mode. Self-service sign-up needs an invite code. The interview guide's paid walk is partial (#2623). The dating of relative source ages is not yet checked against a live search (#2579). Claude runs on the direct Claude API, outside the EU, until Claude on Vertex AI is available (#1564). French is beta until the French quality gate (milestone 83) runs. The legal pages show placeholder publisher details until the deployment sets them. The run dialog can still offer Start when the day's runs are used (#2974). Your data offers no way yet to delete the whole account; deleting the job search leaves the sign-in and the beta place (#3033).
